A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Simple by design.
Clear from the start.

A local care workspace for barangay health workers and midwives, built by Group 03.

Who is E-Nay for?

Barangay health workers and midwives managing maternal and child records. Mothers and children from birth to two years are the people the project is designed to support.

Can I really use it without internet?

Yes, after the first successful visit and offline download on that device. Wait for “Offline ready” in the workspace. Opening the website on a new device still needs a connection. The offline copy includes the workspace, photographs, and guides.

Do my phone and computer share records?

No. Each browser and device keeps its own local records. Use a complete backup to transfer a workspace. Restoring a backup replaces the receiving device's records after you review and confirm it.

What happens to my existing Java project?

The Java console and desktop apps remain available. Import and export their maternal and child text files from Data & backup. Visits, growth, inventory, and other browser-only fields are included in the complete web backup, not in the Java profile files.
